title: Nuraghe towers buried as if by a tidal wave

tellings.quote: they were suddenly submer they were suddenly covered in earth almost like a tidal wave had swept across the island

plain: The nuraghe, ancient stone towers on the island of Sardinia, were at one point suddenly covered in earth, "almost like a tidal wave had swept across the island". Tim Alberino, a guest who looks into ancient sites, offers this to Michels as his own reading, without naming a source. If he is right, some sudden catastrophe buried a whole island's old buildings at once.
